# CDX test fixtures

`CDATA.CDX` and `CDATA.DBF` were generated by Clipper 5.2e via
`DBFCDX.LIB` under the oracle described in `docs/CLIPPER_ORACLE.md`,
session 2026-07-23. The generator (`CX.PRG`) created a two-field
table (`CODE C(10)`, `NVAL N(8,2)`) with three records and two index
tags (`BYCODE`, `BYNVAL`) written into a structural CDX.

Byte-level facts already verified in the session:

- 5120 bytes = ten 512-byte blocks
- Header options `0xE0` = compact + compound-header
- Ascending, MACHINE collation (`DBFCDX.LIB` cannot generate others)
- Tag directory root at offset 1024, holding two entries
- Entry compression: `dup=0 trail=4 chars=6 chunk="BYCODE"` then
  `dup=2 trail=4 chars=4 chunk="NVAL"` (i.e. `BY` shared with the
  previous entry, only `NVAL` written) → keys `BYCODE`, `BYNVAL`
- Companion DBF byte 28 = `0x01` (structural CDX flag)
